text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. When tests are well written, developers gain confidence. They can change or improve their code without fear of breaking things, because the tests will quickly show any problems.
